tei:div.tei:p: 117) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: tshogs mchod rig 'dzin dgyes skong dngos grub myur thob spros med rgyun khyer bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen bsog pa'i thabs: bza' bca' btung ba la sogs dang: māṃ sa dza gad thabs shes rdzas: ci 'byor bshams nas ting 'dzin ngang: hūm̐: snod bcud dag mnyam rol pa las: 'khor 'das yongs dag mchod pa'i rdzas: dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: zag med nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od: bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: kun bzang pad+ma he ru ka: rig 'dzin lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rin chen pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dag pa rab 'byams tshogs mchod 'bul: rig stong zhen bral ngang du bzhes: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: lha sgom spyod pa dag pa yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: gnyis snang bag chags ci bsags pa: dag chen chos dbyings klong du bshags: gzung 'dzin lam gol dam nyams sri: ye shes chen po'i 118) stobs kyis bsgral: gzugs phung tshogs kyi 'khor lo ru: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du stob: ru tra mā ra ya khā hiḥ gsang rdzas thabs shes longs spyod ni: tshim pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la hoḥ snang sems cho 'phrul lhag ma'i mgron: lhag gtor 'di shes phrin las mdzod: he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi mched pa phul ba'i mthus: bdag cag rdo rje'i mchod lcam kun: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu ni: 'og min zhing la spyod par shog: smon lam ci rigs brjod par bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang dam pa gang gis bskul ngor sprang mo mdo med su kha badz+ra gyis dag par bris pa'o// dge'o/ /
